dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: She was right next to me, and the next thing I knew, she ran off somewhere! I swear I only lost sight of her for a second!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Klee is known for her speed. Don't worry — she's a knight in her own right. She can protect herself.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, there you are! Klee's here to help!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: See? Kids are fast on their feet.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Those bombs... I see what you mean. She's not to be underestimated...
